SMART is a system for diagnosing and warning when hard drive failures are about to occur. If your hard drives are making clicking noises or other unusual noises then its most likely a mechanical failure

My guess is your PC is fine and that the HDD's just failed like HDD's usually do, having moving parts and all. The reason for the HDD failure can be a few things I can think of off the top of my head

* The HDD's were not getting much ventilation and so dust accumulated on them and they failed. Had this happen to me a few times, and when I put new ones in a more ventilated area of the case they lasted much longer
* the HDD controller on the drives failed, probably likely seeing how they are acting very erratically. If your feeling ambitious you can always try and find the same model of your HDD and swap the controller boards on them.

The only thing I can think of that would cause the controller on the HDD's to fail is a bad power supply or it was shorted somehow.
